006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.time.Instant;
009import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
010import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
011import java.util.concurrent.atomic.LongAdder;
012
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
015
016/**
017 * Thread-safe accumulator for timing measurements of a single timed entity
018 * (constraint, let-statement, phase, or overall validation).
019 * <p>
020 * Records total elapsed time, invocation count, and min/max per-invocation
021 * durations. Also tracks the wall-clock start and end timestamps in UTC.
022 * <p>
023 * All methods are safe to call from multiple threads concurrently.
024 */
025public class TimingRecord {
026  @NonNull
027  private final LongAdder totalTimeNs = new LongAdder();
028  @NonNull
029  private final LongAdder count = new LongAdder();
030  @NonNull
031  private final AtomicLong minTimeNs = new AtomicLong(Long.MAX_VALUE);
032  @NonNull
033  private final AtomicLong maxTimeNs = new AtomicLong(Long.MIN_VALUE);
034  @NonNull
035  private final AtomicReference<Instant> startTimestampUtc = new AtomicReference<>();
036  @NonNull
037  private final AtomicReference<Instant> endTimestampUtc = new AtomicReference<>();
038
039  /**
040   * Record the start of a timed event. Atomically keeps the earliest start
041   * timestamp across all invocations.
042   *
043   * @param startTimestamp
044   *          the wall-clock time when the event began
045   */
046  void recordStart(@NonNull Instant startTimestamp) {
047    startTimestampUtc.accumulateAndGet(
048        startTimestamp,
049        (prev, next) -> prev == null || next.isBefore(prev) ? next : prev);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Record the completion of a timed event. Atomically keeps the latest end
054   * timestamp across all invocations.
055   *
056   * @param durationNs
057   *          the elapsed time of this invocation in nanoseconds
058   * @param endTimestamp
059   *          the wall-clock time when the event completed
060   */
061  void recordEnd(long durationNs, @NonNull Instant endTimestamp) {
062    totalTimeNs.add(durationNs);
063    count.increment();
064    endTimestampUtc.accumulateAndGet(
065        endTimestamp,
066        (prev, next) -> prev == null || next.isAfter(prev) ? next : prev);
067
068    // update min atomically
069    long currentMin;
070    do {
071      currentMin = minTimeNs.get();
072      if (durationNs >= currentMin) {
073        break;
074      }
075    } while (!minTimeNs.compareAndSet(currentMin, durationNs));
076
077    // update max atomically
078    long currentMax;
079    do {
080      currentMax = maxTimeNs.get();
081      if (durationNs <= currentMax) {
082        break;
083      }
084    } while (!maxTimeNs.compareAndSet(currentMax, durationNs));
085  }
086
087  /**
088   * Get the total accumulated time across all invocations.
089   *
090   * @return total time in nanoseconds
091   */
092  public long getTotalTimeNs() {
093    return totalTimeNs.sum();
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Get the number of times this entity has been timed.
098   *
099   * @return the invocation count
100   */
101  public long getCount() {
102    return count.sum();
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * Get the minimum single-invocation duration recorded.
107   *
108   * @return minimum time in nanoseconds, or {@link Long#MAX_VALUE} if no
109   *         invocations have been recorded
110   */
111  public long getMinTimeNs() {
112    return minTimeNs.get();
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Get the maximum single-invocation duration recorded.
117   *
118   * @return maximum time in nanoseconds, or {@link Long#MIN_VALUE} if no
119   *         invocations have been recorded
120   */
121  public long getMaxTimeNs() {
122    return maxTimeNs.get();
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Get the wall-clock timestamp of the earliest recorded start event.
127   *
128   * @return the start timestamp, or {@code null} if no events have been recorded
129   */
130  @Nullable
131  public Instant getStartTimestampUtc() {
132    return startTimestampUtc.get();
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Get the wall-clock timestamp of the latest recorded end event.
137   *
138   * @return the end timestamp, or {@code null} if no events have completed
139   */
140  @Nullable
141  public Instant getEndTimestampUtc() {
142    return endTimestampUtc.get();
143  }
144}
